agentic.summary: Audit of 26-turn conversation: agent followed verification and data-handling procedures; no policy violations found.

full.summary: No policy violations found. The agent collected only necessary account and order identifiers, completed identity verification before making the delivery-time change, and made no improper promises, payment-data requests, or conduct issues.

rag.summary: Agent requested account ID and order ID and proceeded with identity verification, but did not request the customer's full name which is required for full verification when handling order status queries. No other policy violations were observed in the provided excerpts.

findings.quote: Okay can I have your account ID and order ID please?
findings.explanation: For order status the policy requires full verification (full name, account ID and order ID). The agent asked only for the account ID and order ID and did not request the customer's full name before proceeding with verification (system shows 'Identity verification in progess ...' at turn 9), so verification is incomplete (one required detail missing).
